text: Connect the product to a 240V AC power supply using a Jackery 40A Charging Cable (sold separately). Press the AC power button to enable AC power delivery. All AC output ports support UPS operation under 240V input: NEMA 14-50R (240V~ 60Hz): Up to 9600W bypass output NEMA 5-20R ×2 (120V~ 60Hz): Up to 2400W per port, 4800W total bypass output The maximum total load allowed is 4000 W for a single unit and 8000 W for dual units (parallel connection). When the 240V grid power fails, the system automatically switches to battery power with a transfer time of <10 ms. When the battery is depleted, all AC outputs turn off.
